# ui::testing::TestClipboard

Header: `winui/testing/TestClipboard.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Clipboard`.

An in-memory [Clipboard](../tree/clipboard.md) for headless tests. It holds one [ClipboardContent](../tree/clipboard-content.md) and never touches the system clipboard.

Behaves like the real backend where a test can observe it: [set_text()](#set_text) replaces every part, [set_content()](#set_content) with nothing set fails and leaves the old content, every write and [clear()](#clear) advances [content_changed()](../tree/clipboard.md#content_changed), and [available_formats()](#available_formats) lists the format names a real copy would put on the system clipboard. [`history_enabled`](#history_enabled)/[`roaming_enabled`](#roaming_enabled) are plain fields a test sets.

Install it with [set_clipboard()](namespace-ui-testing.md#set_clipboard) so [ui::clipboard()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#clipboard) and every control use it. It uninstalls itself when destroyed, so a test that ends early never leaves a dangling clipboard behind.

Example: 
```cpp
// A test: Ctrl+V pastes from the clipboard.
ui::testing::TestClipboard clipboard;
ui::testing::set_clipboard(&clipboard);
clipboard.set_text("Portland");
REQUIRE(clipboard.contains(ui::StandardDataFormat::Text));
REQUIRE(clipboard.available_formats() == std::vector<std::string>{"CF_UNICODETEXT"});

auto box = std::make_unique<ui::TextBoxControl>();
ui::testing::set_focused(*box, true);
box->handle_key({ui::Key::V, ui::KeyAction::Down, {.ctrl = true}});
REQUIRE(box->text() == "Portland");

int changes = 0;
ui::Subscription watch = clipboard.content_changed().observe([&](const std::uint64_t&) { ++changes; });
clipboard.clear();
REQUIRE(changes == 1);
REQUIRE_FALSE(clipboard.text().has_value());
```

## set_content

```cpp

```

Stores [`content`](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#content) and [`options`](#options) and raises a change; false (nothing changed) when [`content`](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#content) has no part set.

The stored picture, returned as stored (no encode/decode round trip).

```cpp

```

The stored operation, or None when there are no storage items for it to apply to.

## contains

```cpp
bool contains(StandardDataFormat format) const override
```

Whether the stored content has the part `format` names.

## available_formats

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> available_formats() const override
```

The system format names for the stored parts: `CF_UNICODETEXT` for text, `PNG` and `CF_DIBV5` for a bitmap, `CF_HDROP` and `Preferred DropEffect` for storage items. The history and cloud opt-out markers follow when the options turned those off.

## clear

```cpp
void clear() override
```

Drops the content and options and raises a change.
